_doc: Reveal chapters for the `status` field in punk_records.json. The Spoiler Shield gates a character's life/death status on the chapter the READER LEARNS it — never on the character's debut. Without an entry here a Deceased status is OMITTED for any shielded reader (traceless), and shown only to caught-up readers. Consumed by character.html via bake.py block `status-reveals-data`.

_policy.gate: Show 'Deceased' only when effective cutoff >= ch. Below it show 'Alive'.
_policy.undated: No entry -> omit the Status line entirely while a cutoff is active. Never assert.
_policy.fail_late: When torn between two candidate chapters take the LATER one. Over-hiding is safe; leaking is not.
_policy.rungs: Optional. For characters whose status changes more than once (presumed dead, later revealed alive), supply an ordered `rungs` array of {ch, value} instead of `ch`. Highest rung with ch <= cutoff wins.
_policy.confidence: certain = verified beat | confident = spot-check the number | qa = maintainer must confirm; also listed in _qa_flags
